title: Asheville, NC — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Asheville, NC: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Asheville is a city in NC with a population of 94,589. Mountain hippie haven with breweries, Blue Ridge Parkway, and a vibrant arts scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
